item.name: hold-to-confirm
item.summary: control: Press-and-hold button for destructive actions: it fills, then crumbles to ash left to right; Undo rebuilds it (canvas 2D, native button)

useWhen: A destructive or costly action that deserves a deliberate press (delete, discard, revoke)
Replacing a confirmation dialog with something faster and harder to trigger by accident
avoidWhen: Everyday actions (a hold slows people down)
Actions that cannot be undone, unless you pass undoLabel={null} and say so in the label

alternatives.name: fuse-toast
alternatives.when: When the action should happen at once and offer undo afterwards

tiers.0: The control alone (server render, reduced motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2): no canvas
tiers.2: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 1.5 with half the particles
tiers.3: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 2 with the full particle count

reducedMotion.description: The hold works the same with a filling bar; the button simply disappears when confirmed (no crumble, no canvas).

input.pointer: Press and hold for holdMs; releasing early cancels
input.touch: Press and hold (touch-action: none on the button)
input.keyboard: Hold Enter or Space; releasing early cancels; focus moves to Undo once confirmed and back after undo

a11y.notes: A native <button>; the label should say it needs a hold. Confirmation is announced in a role=status region, which also holds the Undo button (focus moves there). Releasing before holdMs cancels (WCAG 2.5.2). The ash canvas is aria-hidden.

props.name: children
props.effect: Required. The label, which should say that it needs a hold.

props.name: holdMs
props.effect: How long the press must be held, in ms.

props.name: onConfirm
props.effect: The hold completed: do the action.

props.name: undoLabel
props.effect: Label of the undo button; null for no undo.

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the effect (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the effect stops drawing; the control keeps working.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

mistakes: Say "Hold to …" in the label: nothing else tells people a click is not enough.
If the action cannot be undone, pass undoLabel={null} rather than an Undo that does nothing.
The ash falls below and beside the button: do not clip the parent with overflow: hidden.
verify: Server HTML has a native <button> with the label and an empty status region.
Holding Enter for holdMs confirms; releasing early does not.
Undo restores the button and moves focus back to it.
